title: Add app-ads.txt endpoint for Google AdMob verification

requirements.text: Serve a plain-text `app-ads.txt` file at the root URL path `/app-ads.txt` of the application (i.e., accessible at `https://fruitverse-kaz.caffeine.xyz/app-ads.txt`). The file must contain exactly the following line: `google.com, pub-7936595519986908, DIRECT, f08c47fec0942fa0`

quotes: benim için app-ads.txt uzantısını hazırla normal uygulamanın URL sinin uzantısına

acceptanceCriteria: A file named `app-ads.txt` is placed in `frontend/public/` so it is served at the root URL path `/app-ads.txt`.
The file content is exactly: `google.com, pub-7936595519986908, DIRECT, f08c47fec0942fa0` with no extra whitespace or encoding issues.
Navigating to `https://fruitverse-kaz.caffeine.xyz/app-ads.txt` returns the correct plain-text content with HTTP 200.
The file is served with a plain-text MIME type (`text/plain`).
No other pages or routes are affected by this change.

constraints: The app-ads.txt file must be served as a static public asset at the exact path /app-ads.txt — do not route it through the backend canister.
The AdMob publisher ID pub-7936595519986908 must not be altered.
The authorization tag f08c47fec0942fa0 must not be altered.
nonGoals: Do not modify any backend Motoko logic.
Do not change any existing frontend pages or components.
Do not add any UI elements related to the app-ads.txt file.
Do not add additional ad network entries beyond the single Google AdMob line.
